title: Submit a ticket — round 4: the fold highlight, the hand-over to Contribute, Contribute in plain words

steps.path: Settings → About → Privacy, pointer on "Your account"
steps.headline: Pointing at a folded row now lights the whole rounded box, not a square strip inside it.
steps.changed: The highlight used to be a square-cornered band inset from the box's edges. It now fills the box and follows its rounded corners.
steps.notice: Same in every place with folded rows: About, Performance, Backup & sync's Sync log, the status bar's Theme cycle, the ticket, and Contribute.

steps.path: Settings → Performance → opened row, pointer on its header
steps.headline: On an opened row, the highlight fills the header to the box's edges, with rounded top corners.
steps.changed: Was a square band inset from the box; now edge to edge, rounded at the top.
steps.notice: The opened text below the header is unchanged.

steps.path: Review ticket → Optional AI help → Let your assistant try to fix it → Start
steps.headline: "Let your assistant try to fix it" now opens the Contribute screen, worded for your ticket.
steps.changed: It says your assistant will work on your ticket in its own copy of YouCoded's code, that the first time downloads about 1 GB, that your app and files don't change, and that a new conversation opens with your ticket in it.
steps.notice: Your ticket isn't sent. "Back to ticket" returns you to it with everything as you left it.

steps.path: … → when YouCoded's code is already on this computer
steps.headline: If the code is already on this computer, there is no download: one Start button.
steps.changed: The app now finds the copy it made before, even after a restart, and reuses it.
steps.notice: Before, every restart downloaded it again into a new folder.

steps.headline: The first time, it shows the download and says you can go back to your ticket while it runs.
steps.changed: One card: "Downloading YouCoded's code…", about 1 GB, and Back to ticket.
steps.notice: When it finishes, the conversation starts by itself — you pressed "Download and start".

steps.headline: Back on the ticket: tagged "Not sent", with Done and Submit public ticket.
steps.changed: The approved screen from round 2, now reached through Contribute.
steps.notice: The download and download-failed screens are gone from the ticket popup.

steps.headline: Contribute in plain words: what it does, the 1 GB first-time download, that nothing else changes, and what comes next.
steps.changed: "Set up development workspace" and "a separate project" are gone. The button is "Download YouCoded's code".
steps.notice: "How contributing works" is the same five steps; step 3 no longer says "working copy".

steps.path: Contribute, with YouCoded's code already on this computer
steps.headline: When the code is already there, Contribute says "YouCoded's code is ready on this computer".
steps.changed: Was "Your development workspace is ready" — and only until the app restarted. Now it finds the copy on disk every time.
steps.notice: Open it and Not now are unchanged.

steps.headline: Downloading, in one card: "Downloading YouCoded's code…", about 1 GB, and that you can close it.
steps.changed: Was a centred spinner and a loose line under it.
steps.notice: Closing it doesn't stop the download; reopening shows where it got to.

steps.headline: "How contributing works" now opens inside its own box, like every other folded row.
steps.changed: It was a hand-built fold whose steps opened below it; it now uses the shared one.
